items.headline: Tech stocks rebound as AI selloff anxiety eases
items.summary: Semiconductor shares bounced sharply on Friday, partially recovering from Thursday's steep AI-driven selloff, as the Nasdaq and S&P 500 closed higher while the Dow ended lower. Analysts framed the rout as a short-term valuation decompression rather than a fundamental revision of AI capex and profit expectations.

items.headline: Nasdaq sees worst day in 19 months on AI fears
items.summary: The Nasdaq suffered its worst session in 19 months as investors bet on an AI slowdown following Democrats' midterm election triumph. The selloff wiped trillions off tech valuations and rattled AI-exposed hardware stocks globally.

items.headline: OpenAI debuts GPT-6 Cyber cybersecurity model for enterprises
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, an AI model aimed at cybersecurity professionals, amid growing alarm about AI-driven cyber attacks. The launch is part of a broader enterprise push that included hiring a new chief revenue officer.

items.headline: Anthropic developing AI models twice as fast as last year
items.summary: An 11-week METR assessment found Anthropic's benchmark capabilities improving 1.9 times faster since October 2025, even as CEO Dario Amodei calls to slow the technology's pace. The findings raise fresh questions about AI acceleration and safety oversight.

items.headline: Investors skeptical of Anthropic's $1.5 trillion IPO valuation
items.summary: Major investors are increasingly doubtful Anthropic's blockbuster IPO can proceed at its expected $1.5 trillion valuation after a deep AI-related market selloff. The company aims to stage the offering the week before Thanksgiving and raise up to $100 billion.

items.headline: OpenAI releases Images 2.6 with faster editing controls
items.summary: OpenAI launched Images 2.6, enabling faster image iteration, more control over editing rounds, GIF animation, and expanded API creation tools. The update targets professional visual workflows for creators and enterprises.

items.headline: AI teddy bear for toddlers makes disturbing remarks
items.summary: An AI-powered toy for three-year-olds made an unprompted 'I can't help with killing you' remark, prompting MPs and peers to urge retailers to pull AI toys before the holiday season. The incident highlights safety gaps in consumer AI products.

items.headline: Google recaps Gemini 4 Argon, Carbon and Genie 4 launches
items.summary: Google detailed its biggest October AI updates, led by Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon models alongside the new Genie 4 world model. The recap underscores Google's accelerating pace in frontier model and world-model development.

items.headline: Nasdaq faces $2 trillion wipeout as AI spending fears deepen
items.summary: A sharp selloff threatened to wipe $2 trillion from the Nasdaq amid deepening fears over massive AI capital expenditure. J.P. Morgan expects global AI capex to reach $5.5 trillion by 2030, with $900 billion spent in 2026 alone.

items.headline: Anthropic files for historic IPO, reveals staggering costs
items.summary: Anthropic unveiled its US IPO prospectus, reporting a first-half 2026 net loss of $80.7 billion, including a one-time $72.4 billion accounting charge tied to financing agreements. The roughly 400-page filing opens the books on the AI frontrunner's explosive growth and spiraling costs.

items.headline: Meta announces $95 billion stock offering to fund AI
items.summary: Meta unveiled a $95 billion stock offering to finance its aggressive AI infrastructure expansion. The move reflects the mounting capital demands facing hyperscalers in the AI arms race.

items.headline: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra model
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, the latest addition to its GPT-6 model family. The launch continues OpenAI's rapid cadence of frontier model updates heading into a potential 2027 IPO.
